report.disclaimer: This audit is based only on publicly available information.

report.summary.title: WordPress Quality Assessment Summary
finding.notWordpress.evidence: No WordPress signals (generator meta tag, /wp-content/ or /wp-includes/ paths, REST API discovery link) were found on the homepage of {{domain}}.
finding.notWordpress.recommendation: No further action — this tool only assesses WordPress sites.
finding.header.missingHsts.evidence: The Strict-Transport-Security header is missing from the homepage response.
finding.header.missingHsts.recommendatio: Add a Strict-Transport-Security header so browsers always connect over HTTPS.
finding.header.missingCsp.evidence: The Content-Security-Policy header is missing from the homepage response.
finding.header.missingCsp.recommendation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to reduce the impact of injected scripts.
finding.header.missingXFrameOptions.evid: The X-Frame-Options header is missing from the homepage response.
finding.header.missingXFrameOptions.reco: Add an X-Frame-Options (or frame-ancestors CSP directive) header to reduce clickjacking risk.
finding.header.missingXContentTypeOption: The X-Content-Type-Options header is missing from the homepage response.
Add an X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header to stop browsers from guessing content types.
finding.header.infoDisclosure.evidence: The {{header}} header discloses server software details: "{{value}}".
finding.header.infoDisclosure.recommenda: Suppress or generalize the {{header}} header so it doesn't reveal specific software versions.
finding.tls.invalidCertificate.recommend: Renew or reconfigure the TLS certificate so it validates correctly.
finding.tls.outdatedProtocol.evidence: The server negotiated {{protocol}}, an outdated TLS protocol version.
finding.tls.outdatedProtocol.recommendat: Disable outdated TLS protocol versions and require TLS 1.2 or newer.
finding.endpoint.userEnumeration.evidenc: The REST API user list is publicly accessible and exposes {{count}} username(s).
finding.endpoint.userEnumeration.recomme: Restrict or disable the /wp-json/wp/v2/users endpoint to stop username enumeration.
finding.endpoint.xmlrpcEnabled.evidence: xmlrpc.php responds to requests and is publicly reachable.
finding.endpoint.xmlrpcEnabled.recommend: Disable XML-RPC if it isn't required, to reduce the attack surface.
finding.endpoint.directoryListing.eviden: The uploads directory returns a browsable file listing instead of a 403/404.
finding.endpoint.directoryListing.recomm: Disable directory listing on the web server for upload directories.
finding.endpoint.configBackupExposed.evi: A configuration backup file is publicly downloadable: {{paths}}.
finding.endpoint.configBackupExposed.rec: Remove exposed wp-config.php backup files immediately — they can leak database credentials and secret keys.
finding.plugin.outdated.evidence: The {{slug}} plugin is at version {{installed}}, but {{latest}} is the latest version on WordPress.org.
finding.plugin.outdated.recommendation: Update the {{slug}} plugin to the latest version to receive bug fixes and security patches.
